15.t: Working with data: chlorine and methane
q: In which tube did the chlorine disappear fastest?
Substitution: a Cl atom replaces an H atom.
Without light there is no reaction, even when warmed: the reaction needs UV light, not heat.
Explain why tube 3 contained CH₂Cl₂ as well as CH₃Cl.
With lots of chlorine and UV, the reaction continues: a second H in CH₃Cl is also substituted, giving a mixture of products.
